# Shared core: do not edit here

This folder is a read-only copy of the **house** repo (`neocreo-app/house`):
`brands/`, `rules/`, and `web/`. The shared skills in `.claude/skills/` (safe-push,
copy-pass, sync-core, new-site) come from there too.

- Synced from house commit: `0bd7d74`
- To change anything here: edit it in house, push house, then run `/sync-core` in this repo.
